Intent i010 (SNAPSHOT=s03, BRANCH=tx-cow-head-realloc) complete. Searched only snapshots/s03: automated audit of every skb_cow_head/skb_cow/skb_unclone/skb_share_check/pskb_expand_head/skb_linearize call site in net/ and drivers/ for functions that capture a pointer into skb head/data before the call and use it after; 12 flagged functions were manually classified. Two credible findings of the seed's stale-pointer-after-head-reallocation pattern: (1) net/mac80211/tdls.c:2010-2037 ieee80211_process_tdls_channel_switch() — tf = (void*)skb->data captured at 2010, skb_linearize(skb) at 2020 (can pskb_expand_head/free the old head for cloned/non-linear skbs), then 'switch (tf->action_code)' at 2026 dereferences the stale pointer without refetching; reached from the remote-attacker-controlled ETH_P_TDLS RX worker (net/mac80211/iface.c:1815); medium confidence, single-byte stale read (KASAN UAF), reallocation precondition not dynamically reproduced. (2) drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7925/mcu.c:642-648 mt7925_mcu_rx_event() — rxd captured from skb->data at 642, skb_linearize at 644, 'rxd->option' read at 647 without refetch; low confidence since the skb source is on-device firmware and linearity of MCU event skbs unproven. Negative evidence: ten other flagged candidates verified safe (mac80211 wpa.c CCMP/GCMP/TKIP/MIC paths explicitly reload hdr after skb_linearize; iwlwifi dvm tx.c refetches hdr after pskb_expand_head; nf_flow_table_ip.c tunnel pushes refetch iph/ip6h after skb_cow_head; ipv6 exthdrs.c ipv6_dest_hao and ip6_forward refetch after pskb_expand_head/skb_cow; hdlc_fr.c fr_rx uses skb_share_check which does not reallocate the same head buffer). Bounded limitations: audit regex only catches direct header-accessor pointer captures in the calling function; ~40 skb_cow_head sites (ip_gre, seg6/rpl/ioam6 iptunnel, nsh, ife, psp, sch_frag, br_netfilter, l2tp, xfrm, batman-adv, phonet) were pattern-screened with capture typically after the cow, not all deep-read; arch/ and fs/ not audited. Final artifact at agent-state/findings/i010.json; checkpoint updated.
